top_signals.summary: Ukraine will give Britain access to a vast trove of battlefield data collected during the war with Russia, allowing U.K. companies and researchers to use it to train and test artificial intelligence systems.

top_signals.title: Treasuries Gain as Oil Drop Eases Pressure on Inflation, Bessent
top_signals.summary: Treasuries gained as a decline in crude-oil prices eased inflation concerns and pressure on Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who has been trying to halt a months-long selloff that pushed the longest-dated yields to the highest in almost two decades.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Kalshi traders see low likelihood of major crypto bill becoming law this year
top_signals.summary: The White House has pushed for Congress to pass the Clarity Act, a bill on crypto regulation. Kalshi traders see little chance the bill becomes law this year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
